messages.subject: Timer() extract values
parts:
Hello,

I am not a specialist in sounds and in R (or seewave) neither. I am quite sure that is possible to do what I want. So do not be suprised if it is easy for you or that you think that I did not search, I did, but I think that I do not have some basis to understand how to do.

My goal is to detect peaks in amplitude function of the time. Right, this is possible with timer(). I think that I have understood partially how it works and tried on some sounds of my database. I played with threshold, power, and msmooth (I am not sure how it works and what is the difference with k and ssmooth ...) to arrive to detect the peaks that I wanted.

Now I want to synthesize for each a wave if there are peaks that are :
  • Closed to each other, for example less than x ms
  • To create a group of peaks that are close to each other
  • How many peaks there are in this group of closed peaks
  • the mean amplitude of peaks in a group
  • The lenght in time of the group

Do you think that is it possible to extract this in a table or something like this ? (maybe first how to export value from timer()).

Regards.

Dorian.
